fusions.name: Lulling Wash
fusions.desc: A slow wave that deals 8 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, strips 10% armour for 6 seconds and slows each by 30%, then stuns each for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sipped Surge
fusions.desc: Fires a jet of water that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Calm Water
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Easy Does It
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 50%, every heal reaching you is worth 30% more for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds. You gain 5% dodge chance.
